title: Discourse Brief
description: Per-chapter rhetorical plan produced by the narrative-briefer agent. Encodes the discourse layer: how to tell the chapter's story, not what the chapter contains.

chapter_id.description: Canonical chapter identifier matching the architecture.

value_shift.description: The reader's belief transformation across this chapter.

before.description: What the reader believes entering the chapter.

after.description: What the reader believes leaving the chapter.

chapter_form.description: story: single arc (complication → resolution). layer_cake: action line with explanatory digressions.

opening_mode.description: How the chapter opens. No two adjacent chapters should use the same mode.

nut_graf.description: The paragraph that names the chapter's driving question and urgency.

paragraph_position.description: Which paragraph (2-6) carries the nut graf. Paragraph 1 is the hook.

question.description: The driving question this chapter exists to answer.

urgency.description: Why this question demands an answer now.

beats.description: Rhetorical sequence of scene and exposition beats. This is NOT a heading list — it is the chapter's argumentative rhythm.

mode.description: scene: concrete, immersive, specific. exposition: analytical, contextual, general.

purpose.description: What this beat does for the reader.

known.description: What the reader knows entering this beat (from the previous beat or chapter).

new.description: What the reader learns from this beat. Becomes the 'known' for the next beat.

show_tell_sowhat.description: Optional. The show-tell-so-what micro-pattern for this beat.

show.description: A concrete example, scene, or anecdote.

tell.description: The analytical point the example illustrates.

so_what.description: Why it matters to the reader or the book's thesis.

evidence_weaving.description: How verified claims arrive in the chapter — as stories, examples, data points, or contrasts.

arrives_as.description: The rhetorical vehicle for this claim.

human_consequence.description: What this claim means for a person, not what it means as a data point.

closing_pull.description: How the final paragraph creates momentum toward the next chapter.

chapter_bans.description: Chapter-specific negative constraints beyond global style rules.
